entities.name: War of the Eight Princes
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary:
The War of the Eight Princes was a series of civil wars that ravaged the Western Jin dynasty from 291 to 306 CE, pitting the eight sons of Emperor Wu against each other in a struggle for power and control.

This devastating conflict was sparked by the death of Emperor Wu in 290 CE, which sparked a power vacuum that the princes were ill-equipped to navigate.

The war would ultimately lead to the downfall of the Western Jin dynasty and the rise of the Eastern Jin dynasty, which would go on to shape the course of Chinese history.

As the historian Chen Shou noted, 'The war of the eight princes was a calamity that shook the foundations of the Western Jin, a tragedy that would haunt the descendants of the Wu family for generations to come.'
